A '''38 anticoncussion field generator''' was a model of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] manufactured by the [[Nordoxicon/Legends|Nordoxicon]] company during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGVV" /> The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had one placed on board during its refit in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].

[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]]'s personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] ''[[Storm (Miy'til starfighter)|Storm]]'', was equipped with four banks of 38 anticoncussion field generators.<ref name="EGVV" />
